programme.title: Play School: Big Ted's Time Machine
programme.desc: Step back in time to the swinging 60s with Justine and Alex where they meet Play School icon, Monica! Big Ted plays hide and seek, and hopscotch with the other toys. They have fondue for lunch and watch the moon landing!

programme.title: Fireman Sam
programme.desc: When a class tour of the airport goes wrong, it's up to Norman to use his gaming skills to control FireSwift until the Rescue Team arrives!

programme.title: Zip And The Tiny Sprouts
programme.desc: Zip is determined to get to the tippy top of the Wonder Tree! But when the rain makes the final climb too slippery, will he persevere?

programme.title: The Woohoos!
programme.desc: Elephant comes to visit the Woohoos, and he comes with a new bird friend on his head. When Pecky Bird is accidently scared away Elephant starts to itch! Eventually they realise that Pecky Bird was keeping the itchy bugs away!

programme.title: Nikhil & Jay
programme.sub-title: Nikhil and Jay and the Monsooooooon!
programme.desc: Nikhil and Jay want to be in the monsoon rain. But it's not raining.and they don't just want rain, rain, they want MONSOON rain, like their Chennai Grandparents have.

programme.title: Miffy and Friends
programme.desc: After a snowfall, Miffy and Bun build a "snow friend" to play with, and Miffy promises Bun they will include it in all the fun winter games they play outside with their friends.

programme.title: The Sound Collector
programme.desc: The Sound Collector finds a cello, which makes a lot of different sounds. But whose is it?

programme.title: Mittens & Pants
programme.desc: Monsieur LaFleur has grown his first ever head of lettuce! He drives very slowly to deliver it to town, too slowly in fact, Pants fears he may never make it to Peppermint's grocery store on time.

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: MeMo and BaBa can't get rid of a sticky leaf but then find surprising ways to play with it.

programme.title: The Fantus Show
programme.desc: The children run between the trees and Fantus meets a clapping monkey

programme.title: Ready Eddie Go!
programme.desc: Baking a chocolate cake means a trip to the supermarket, where Eddie navigates the smells and sounds of the big shop.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: It's lunchtime on Bluey's back deck! But every BBQ needs a side salad, so Bingo's relaxing sit-down will have to wait until she finds every colour of capsicum her cousin's asked for!

programme.title: Fizzy And Suds
programme.desc: Fizzy and Suds meet robots that build, explore Mars, and help people! One special robot helps kids with blindness to find their way, and another robot even gives cuddles!

programme.title: Gardening Australia Junior
programme.desc: Tammy and the kids create mini succulent cities from succulents and cacti complete with lights, little cars, dinosaurs and waterslides.

programme.title: The Wiggles: Wiggle and Learn
programme.desc: Explore musical dynamics with The Wiggles! Join with Evie as she teaches Captain Feathersword about the importance of volume and tone.

programme.title: Iron Man and His Awesome Friends
programme.desc: Riri wants to play paper boats, but Swarm has drained the creek to ruin the park.

programme.title: Mecha Builders
programme.desc: Ranger Nat can't wait to see Pinecone's Comet, that is, until his telescope falls to the bottom of a cliff.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends
programme.desc: Toby's passengers can't stop making fun of him, but they soon change their mind when he stops two villains trying to steal King Godred's Crown.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Mummy Pig orders a new toy cupboard. It arrives in the post and has to be assembled. Mummy and Daddy Pig are not very good at DIY. Luckily help is to hand; Mr Zebra the Postman loves assembling flat pack furniture.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Peppa and her friends are going camping. First they put up their tents. Then they collect sticks for a campfire. At bedtime Peppa and her friends get a little scared so they all end up sleeping in Madame Gazelle's tent.

programme.title: Kiri and Lou
programme.desc: Kiri and Lou decide to go swimming but the water is too cold for Lou. When Kiri splashes him and laughs, Lou's feelings are hurt.

programme.title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
programme.desc: The innocent looking Dragonfruitflyus has a cheeky habit of mimicking the noises of other Vegesaurs, so when the baby Pea-Rexes catch on they can't help but turn it into a competition.

programme.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom
programme.desc: There is a new fox cub leader in The Little Kingdom. It's Nanny Plum, also known as Fluffy Owl. Whilst attempting to earn their adventure badges the fox cubs find themselves stuck at the top of Mount Everest with no way down.

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: When Popcorn runs on his hamster wheel all night, he's cranky the next day. But will he nap?

programme.title: Talking Tom Heroes: Suddenly Super
programme.desc: Ben stayed up all night trying to communicate with the EGG and now he keeps falling asleep during the team's missions.

programme.title: Santiago of the Seas
programme.desc: Tomas breaks his guitar while trying to retrieve the golden guitar of his idol and learns that music comes from within.

programme.title: PJ Masks
programme.desc: After not listening to warnings from Newton, Hornwaggle and the PJ Masks, Pirate Robot gets himself and Newton captures by Motsuki. It's when he learns to listen that he is able to escape and rescue newton.

programme.title: The Octonauts
programme.sub-title: The Octonauts And The Jelly Fish Bloom
programme.desc: When Shellington gets trapped in the middle of a massive Jellyfish bloom, it's up to the Octonauts to rescue him!

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Duggee is interrupted reading the paper as the Squirrels are causing a mess around him. He takes a moment to explain that the Squirrels need to think more carefully about what they are doing.

programme.title: Kangaroo Beach
programme.desc: The cadets are planning an epic surprise pool party for Phillipa's birthday but when things get out of hand, they forget the golden pool rule: keep the gate shut.

programme.title: Fireman Sam
programme.desc: It's time for the Big Pontypandy Talent Show! But when Elvis knocks a drink over the drone control panel, the drones crash land, causing many fires.

programme.title: Nikhil & Jay
programme.sub-title: Nikhil and Jay and the King of Cricket
programme.desc: After Amma tells them that Thatha is the King of Cricket, Nikhil and Jay try their hardest to play cricket so they can be the Kings of Cricket too!

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: All aboard for a riotous railway ride as the Numberblocks try to stop a runaway train.

programme.title: Monster Makes
programme.desc: Murphi is so good at hiding that Rebecca decides to make a cardboard tube tracker dog. The Recycling Express brings a shoe box, which becomes home to a magnificent monster.

programme.title: Gardening Australia Junior
programme.desc: Gen, Pia and Romeo are bursting with garden knowledge and are ready to go solo: no grown ups allowed! They draw a planting plan, grab their gloves and get in the dirt. The kids have got it covered - no help is needed.

programme.title: Play School: When I Grow Up
programme.desc: Alex and Matt learn all about health care jobs! Nurse Ari explains how nurses take care of people, and Nurse Jemima flies her rescue helicopter to help injured toys! Matt the Vet visits Alex who is a very hoarse horse!

programme.title: Ready, Steady, Wiggle!
programme.desc: Lucia sings with meerkats, and Buddy explores an amusement park. Play word fun in the kitchen with Lucia and Simon, join a conga line, and end with a performance of 'Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star'.

programme.title: Fizzy And Suds
programme.desc: Fizzy and Suds are thrilled by the colours and shapes of all kinds of butterflies. They even learn about the lifecycle of butterflies with the help of some fairy bread!

programme.title: Lil' stompers
programme.sub-title: L'il Day at the Beach and Other Stories
programme.desc: Collins make his mom a gift for Mother's Day, but it gets ruined by the wind. He's worried he won't have a gift for her, but Billy and Chase hear him sing, and that gives them an idea.

programme.title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
programme.desc: To plug an air vent at the bottom of the lake, Ginger and the Baby Pea-Rexes must seek the help of the mighty Watermelonsuchus!

programme.title: Andy's Global Adventures
programme.sub-title: Andy And The Blue Eyed Black Lemurs
programme.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout head to the island of Madagascar off the coast of Southern Africa to find out how blue-eyed black lemurs deal with itchy bugs.

programme.title: Santiago of the Seas
programme.desc: Santiago is on a mad dash to get his compass back after it's nabbed by Bonnie Bones and Sir Butterscotch.

programme.title: Superkitties
programme.desc: Sparks relies on his problem-solving skills to stop Cat Burglar and Lab Rat from stealing a giant cheese wheel.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The sun is setting, and the squirrels are sitting on the sofa. Suddenly all the lights go out. Oh dear, there's been a power cut. Thanks goodness Duggee has got his torch, and he has torches for everyone.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Dad pretends he was born yesterday. Bluey and Bingo have to guide him through his second day on Earth, especially when he discovers food is delicious and steals Lucky's Dad's pie.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: It is World Book Day at playgroup but Peppa has so many favourite books she just cannot decide which to go as.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Peppa, George, Mummy and Daddy go on a trip to the children's festival where there is singing, making crafts and listening to stories. They stay overnight in a tent, though it looks like it's going to rain.

programme.title: Kiri and Lou
programme.desc: The friends are all playing hide and seek. Lou is the seeker, but he falls asleep before he can count to ten.

programme.title: The Octonauts
programme.desc: The Octonauts attempt to keep the peace amongst a trio of mudskippers whose home has been flooded.

programme.title: Talking Tom Heroes: Suddenly Super
programme.desc: When a gold statue goes missing, the Heroes think a shadowy figure's behind it, only to discover it's Shade, a new hero.
